name: m365-attachment-reader-mcp-local
description: Read Outlook emails and parse their attachments via Microsoft Graph. Optional, off-by-default email composing (drafts or send) with attachments.
long_description: A local single-user MCP server for Claude Desktop that authenticates to Microsoft 365 using device code flow, lists Outlook messages and attachments, reads email bodies, and parses attachment content including OCR-scanned PDFs (Vietnamese + English), Word, PowerPoint, Excel, images, archives, and Outlook MSG files. By default it is read-only (Mail.Read). Email composing is opt-in via the extension settings: when enabled it creates Outlook drafts (Mail.ReadWrite), optionally sends immediately (Mail.Send), restricts recipients to allowed domains, and only attaches local files from a folder you choose.

m365_client_id.title: Microsoft Entra App Client ID
m365_client_id.description: Application (client) ID from your Microsoft Entra app registration.

m365_tenant_id.title: Tenant ID
m365_tenant_id.description: Optional Microsoft Entra tenant ID. Use common for most personal or multi-tenant setups.

m365_auto_open_browser.title: Auto-open browser
m365_auto_open_browser.description: If enabled, begin_auth will try to open the Microsoft login page automatically.

m365_ocr_langs.title: OCR languages
m365_ocr_langs.description: Tesseract language codes for OCR of scanned PDFs, joined by + (e.g. vie+eng). Language data is downloaded once on first use. Leave blank for vie+eng.

m365_enable_send.title: Enable email composing
m365_enable_send.description: Allow Claude to create Outlook email drafts (with attachments). Off = strictly read-only. Turning this on requests Mail.ReadWrite: add it in Entra and run begin_auth again.

m365_allow_send_now.title: Allow sending immediately
m365_allow_send_now.description: Allow Claude to send emails directly instead of only saving drafts. Requires "Enable email composing". Requests Mail.Send: add it in Entra and run begin_auth again.

m365_send_allowed_domains.title: Allowed recipient domains
m365_send_allowed_domains.description: Optional comma-separated list (e.g. company.com, partner.vn). Leave blank to allow any recipient.

m365_send_attachments_dir.title: Attachments folder
m365_send_attachments_dir.description: Folder Claude may attach local files from. Leave blank to disable local file attachments (attachments from existing emails still work).

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Check whether the local Outlook attachment MCP server is running.

tools.name: begin_auth
tools.description: Start Microsoft 365 device-code login for the local MCP server.

tools.name: auth_status
tools.description: Check whether Microsoft 365 login has completed.

tools.name: list_recent_messages
tools.description: List recent Outlook emails and whether they have attachments.

tools.name: list_email_attachments
tools.description: List attachments for a specific Outlook email.

tools.name: read_email_attachment
tools.description: Download and parse an Outlook attachment, including OCR and image-based formats.

tools.name: read_email
tools.description: Read the full text/body of a specific Outlook email (subject, sender, recipients, date, body).

tools.name: check_email_security
tools.description: Check emails for phishing and marketing signals: real link destinations, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, Microsoft spam/bulk scores, sender mismatches, risky attachments.

tools.name: list_sendable_files
tools.description: List files in the configured attachments folder (only when email composing is enabled).

tools.name: send_outlook_email
tools.description: Create an Outlook draft or send an email, with optional attachments from the attachments folder or existing emails (only when email composing is enabled).

tools.name: reply_email
tools.description: Reply (or reply-all) to an existing Outlook email keeping the quoted thread, optionally with attachments, as a draft or sent immediately (only when email composing is enabled).

tools.name: forward_email
tools.description: Forward an existing Outlook email (keeping its original body and attachments) to new recipients, as a draft or sent immediately (only when email composing is enabled).
